mapper.select:
select c.channel_num, c.team_num, c.channel_name, c.category, c.channel_desc, c.is_default,
(select count(*) from chat_message m where m.channel_num = c.channel_num and m.message_num > rs.last_read_message_num) as unreadCount,
(select content from chat_message where message_num = (select max(message_num) from chat_message where channel_num = c.channel_num) ) as lastMessage,
(select to_char(send_date,'AM HH:MI') from chat_message where message_num = (select max(message_num) from chat_message where channel_num = c.channel_num) ) as lastTime from chat_channel c left outer join chat_read_status rs on c.channel_num = rs.channel_num and rs.user_num = #{user_num} where c.team_num = #{team_num} order by c.channel_num asc

select m.message_num, m.channel_num, m.user_num, m.content, m.parent_message, m.send_date, u.user_name as userName, f.file_num, f.origin_name, f.file_type, f.file_size from chat_message m join users u on m.user_num = u.user_num left outer join chat_file f on m.message_num = f.message_num where m.channel_num = #{channel_num} order by m.message_num asc
mapper.insert:
select seq_chat_channel.nextval from dual
insert into chat_channel( channel_num, team_num, channel_name, create_date, create_by, channel_desc, category )values ( #{channel_num}, #{team_num}, #{channel_name}, sysdate, #{create_by}, #{channel_desc}, #{category} )
